rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing functions stay, scripted reactions go. Forcing functions live in prompts, not body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: STILL UNRESOLVED — re-verified against the current file, byte-identical to the prior audit. Lines 24-27 (## Read the diff and push back on a line): 'Read the diff. If a line isn't what you'd have written, push back. Quote the line and say why. Whoever has the better argument wins. Your own wording matters. No pre-made prompt for the pushback.' This is a mandatory, load-bearing teaching beat, not an optional refinement — one of two disciplines named in 'The point' (line 9, 'Both get practised here'), Theme 4 in the maintainer block ('the diff push-back; Claude explains what it wrote and the student verifies'), and Leap Test outcome #2 in the module file (getting-going.md, per this exercise's own leap-test block: 'Pushes back on at least one line in a diff before merging' — a falsifiable Monday-morning outcome). Per the removal test (check_pedagogy.md §16), cutting this instruction collapses the exercise's second discipline — it is a forcing function, and the rule's WHERE-clause puts it in a fence, not body prose. The read-each-phase-prompt-only diagnostic fails: a student who pastes fix-tests-first-1 then fix-tests-first-2 in sequence never encounters this instruction. The regenerated sim trace's confusion_flags entry (phase 1) independently reconfirms this exact risk, unchanged from the prior run: mitigated only by in-room trainer narration, which the artifact itself doesn't structurally guarantee.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: KNOWN, IN FLIGHT — not a fresh finding. Fix is scoped as a new prompt registry file, curriculum/prompts/fix-tests-first-pushback.md (open-hook shape per check_prompts.md §1d, mirroring fix-tests-first-1's own open-hook pattern — internal action paragraph plus a closing colon line the student fills with their own wording, e.g. 'Push back on a line in the diff. Quote the line and say why:'). This preserves the student's-own-wording design intent while making the forcing function reachable by a fast operator or self-study reader who skips body prose between prompts. New prompt-registry files are gated by check_prompts.md §22 (maintainer-approval card + `.claude/prompt-approvals/<key>.confirmed` marker) — confirmed via `.claude/prompt-approvals/` that no approval marker exists yet for this key. Card is pending with Antti. This judge does not re-propose an alternative fix; the correct fix is already identified and blocked on maintainer sign-off, not on further judge analysis.
